name: alicankorkmaz-marketplace
description: Learning skills for coding agents: fast-learning (speed to functional competence by a deadline) and road-to-mastery (depth-first mentorship to expertise).

plugins.name: fast-learning
plugins.description: Teach the user to do one concrete thing with a topic by a deadline: placement test, 20% syllabus, retrieval checks, spaced-retrieval queue, graded explain-backs.

plugins.name: road-to-mastery
plugins.description: Mentor the user from their current level to mastery: mission, diagnosis, adaptive challenges with multi-approach expert feedback, elite mental models, spaced recall.
